This plot is not mine, I only rent it, so I will not put much money into it. Beans do not need fertilizer like maize does — my mother and grandmother never used the white bag on beans, and my neighbors here do not either. I will save my seed from last harvest like always, and my daughter and I will weed it by hand. The rains come when they come, I have no way to bring water to this plot.
